note: Outbound weather and climate links for each public trip, by area (Q298: links only, no weather API call from our pages). We store the link, its publisher and the date we read it; we never fetch, copy or store the publisher's forecast or climate values. Every coordinate inside a URL comes from our own base points, OSM or Wikidata, never Google; it is a lookup key for the publisher's page, not a stored place point.

privacy.sr_only: (opens in a new tab, third-party site)
privacy.rule: The link carries no visitor data: no query we add, no party or trip parameters. noreferrer stops the browser sending our page URL (which can carry the youngest-age band and adult count, D6) as the Referer. Nothing is fetched from these services by our pages or our build.

selection_rule: The page reads trips[trip == trip id]. It shows forecast rows first, in the order stored (the order of the bases), then mountain and aurora rows, then climate rows. A row whose check.reachable is false is not drawn; if a trip has no drawable forecast row, the page draws the fallback. A days view may pick the rows whose bases include the day base name.
